Name: Wooden Hutch
Author: Lavliette
Description:
Wanted to overhaul the hutch a bit and so I did.
Choose between two versions.


[b]IMPORTANT
[/b]
• The right entry tile is kinda borked, so you can walk out of bounds. 
(I suggest you place a chest, your Mini-Shipping bin or whatever else you want next to it (see image #3))

• Make sure to clear out your Slime Hutch completely before installing this mod.
(Otherwise you might have Slimes chilling in unreachable locations)

• The Watertroughs are decorational (aka they don't work)
[u]

[b]Requirements[/b][/u]
• SMAPI
• Content Patcher
• Daisyniko's Tilesheets

[i]Compatible with Generic Mod Config Menu[/i]

[u][b]Installation[/b]
[/u]• Install all the Requirements
• Download this mod and open the .zip folder
• Put the unzipped folder [CP] Wooden Hutch into your Mods


[i]Check out my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11210]Wooden Cellar[/url] for a matching look! :D[/i]
